verdict.rationale: LanceDB's storage layer explicitly supports running on local NVMe/EBS/EFS or any S3-compatible object store, meaning self-hosted deployments let a customer choose where the underlying data physically lives, and Enterprise security docs mention GDPR compliance. However, there is no explicit LanceDB Cloud region-selection feature, no documented list of hosting regions, and no first-party statement on data residency guarantees. Missing for 10: explicit region-picker/region list for the managed/cloud offering, documented data residency policy, and independent confirmation of region controls in practice.
